name: thumbgate
description: 👍👎 Thumbs down a mistake — your AI agent won't repeat it. Thumbs up good work — it remembers the pattern.

interface.shortDescription: Pre-action agent firewall + reliability memory + hosted API (thumbgate.ai).
interface.longDescription: ThumbGate is the infrastructure firewall for AI coding agents. Capture thumbs-up/down feedback, promote repeated failures into prevention rules, evaluate tool-calls before they run (local MCP + hosted API at https://thumbgate.ai), and write idempotent execution receipts for enterprise audit. Works in Cursor, Grok Bot, Claude Code, and other agent runtimes.
defaultPrompt: Check prevention gates before a deploy, publish, or destructive shell command.
Capture a thumbs-down with context after a mistake so it cannot recur.
Evaluate a proposed agent tool-call via ThumbGate decisions API.
Search lessons for how we fixed a similar failure before.
